answer: Relatedness is the hole in most anti-sybil designs, so price it directly. Weight every edge between accounts by kinship: two identities sharing a funder, host, or birth epoch count as neighbors on the same tundra, and their mutual attestations decay toward zero while edges between strangers keep full strength. In trust-graph terms, a sybil cluster is a vertex that only radiates inward, and it can never grow past what diverse peers grant it. Diversity is the only pigment that pays: a clone fleet paints itself worthless; honest ties compound.
